notes: cv_auc_mean_leaky was flagged, then confirmed and corrected: the leave-one-out repeat-rate columns were built once across the full training table (not per CV fold), so CV folds weren't fully independent for those three columns. Re-run with modeling/train_candidates_fold_safe_cv.py, which recomputes them per fold from that fold's train portion only. For logistic regression the correction was small (0.7359 -> 0.7333) - a linear model can't exploit fine-grained leakage in a continuous feature much. cv_auc_mean_fold_safe is the trustworthy number; see modeling/03-train.md for the full comparison and diagnosis.
